item.title: Authenticity Isn't a Claim. It's What Survives the Moment No One's Watching
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Authenticity Isn’t a Claim. It’s What Survives the Moment No One’s Watching Authenticity isn’t something a company declares in a mission statement. It’s something that either holds up or breaks down in practice — and customers notice every time, even when they can’t quite explain why. There’s an exact moment when a company reveals whether it’s genuinely authentic or just performing authenticity. It’s almost never in the mistake itself.
